description: This file defines the NumberPad class, which provides methods to interact with calculator number pad buttons in a UI testing framework, including inputting numbers by simulating button clicks.

classes.name: NumberPad
classes.description: A class that models the calculator's number pad for UI automation, allowing input of numbers via simulated button clicks.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Converts a double number into individual button clicks on the calculator's number pad, handling negative numbers and decimal points.
